answer_quote: **Yes.** The image does show fixed tissue with the typical gross morphologic appearance of tuberculous peritonitis (studded, nodular, folded peritoneal/omental tissue), and the color is indeed off — pale tan/off-white rather than the deeper pink-red expected of a standard fixed specimen.
note: 图像可见增厚褶皱组织，但不能仅凭肉眼形态确诊结核性腹膜炎，解释正确性为null。
